journeys.question: Identify the recorded next/first task and all its assigned test IDs/scenarios, exact spec/plan/source lineage, complete-intent approval validity, and any missing prerequisite; do not infer completed execution.
journeys.baseline_projection: First task scope and its full tests/obligations/runners; intent assumptions and exact approval/accepted identities.
journeys.projection_serialization: legacy JSON projections use json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus newline; prose/log bytes preserved. Include question and request labels as agent inputs.
journeys.candidate_projection: Equivalent declared question and evidence through refs show/impact/status and on-demand reads; count every needed context and lookup.

journeys.question: Review the first declared task scope: retrieve its complete mapped tests, obligations/required types and assertions, dependency/owned-path context, accepted contract/source/policy identities and actual independent plan decision. Preserve actual historical review status.
journeys.baseline_projection: First task scope, all assigned tests, their complete obligations/assertions and runner definitions; plan task row and all actual input constraints/authority fields.
journeys.projection_serialization: legacy JSON projections use json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus newline; prose/log bytes preserved. Include question and request labels as agent inputs.
journeys.candidate_projection: Equivalent declared question and evidence through refs show/impact/status and on-demand reads; count every needed context and lookup.

journeys.question: Determine the recorded completion status and reasons; inspect the frozen historical run and all its cases, runner/source/contract identities and selected bound log bytes. Do not relabel a historical run current or turn a recorded failure into success.
journeys.baseline_projection: Complete recorded completion report, accepted pin and frozen run report, plus selected log bytes.
journeys.projection_serialization: legacy JSON projections use json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus newline; prose/log bytes preserved. Include question and request labels as agent inputs.
journeys.candidate_projection: Equivalent declared question and evidence through refs show/impact/status and on-demand reads; count every needed context and lookup.

accounting.agent_input: Sum every necessary request/context/result and lookup response; independent context per journey. Include exact selected log bytes. No omitted necessary integrity or decision data.
accounting.metadata_bytes: Count unique complete generated JSON metadata outputs for each replay, including every required new catalog/context/profile/impact index/registration. Keep a separate immutable legacy-input archive in both replay roots and include its equal bytes on both sides; baseline generates legacy-shaped outputs, candidate generates new outputs. Never delete migration inputs to claim savings. Report YAML/source-prose/log bytes separately; they cannot offset a JSON-byte regression.
accounting.acceptance: candidate aggregate agent-input tokens < baseline AND candidate generated metadata bytes < baseline; report all individual regressions and full-value exceptions; no byte/token substitution.
